questions.stem: A 20-Year-old primigravida with 12 weeks of gestation presents for ANC. She has no comorbidities. On examination, P-90/min, pallor +, BP-128/84mmHg, RR-12/min, saturation normal, afebrile. The first dose of tetanus vaccine was administered. She was advised routine lab investigations and usg in the previous visit. Her lab investigations are normal. Her usg shows single Intrauterine live fetus with normal growth. True about the physiological changes in pregnancy are all except:

options.label: B
options.text: Increased blood supply to vagina causes bluish coloration of mucosa

options.label: C
options.text: Hypertrophy and hyperplasia of muscles of uterus

options.label: D
options.text: Brownish black discoloration in midline due to melanocyte stimulating hormone
